notes: The district mandal page already reflects G.O.Ms.No.520 dated 30 Dec 2025: Mandapeta, Rayavaram and Kapileswarapuram (moved from Konaseema) are listed under Rajamahendravaram division, giving 13 + 9 = 22 mandals, matching the about page and home page. Mandal names keep the site's spellings Rajahmundry Rural and Rajahmundry Urban, while the division and the corporation use Rajamahendravaram. The district's public-utility municipality listing is stale (it still shows ULBs of the undivided pre-2022 district such as Kakinada and Amalapuram), so ULBs were taken from the home page count of 3 municipalities plus the PMAY 2.0 district-wise list (Rajahmundry MC, Mandapeta, Kovvur, Nidadavole); Kovvur and Nidadavole also have official municipal sites at kovvur.cdma.ap.gov.in and nidadavole.cdma.ap.gov.in.
